# BPMN Desk 0.5.0

- **Copy between diagrams in the same window.** A shared clipboard preserves selected groups, connections, subprocesses, boundary events and Flowable/Camunda 7 extensions. Each diagram retains its own undo/redo history; copied elements remain available after closing the source tab.
- **Preserve referenced definitions when pasting.** Errors, messages, signals and escalations are copied with ID collision handling. Repeated pastes from the same clipboard reuse definitions already imported into the destination.
- **Reorder workspace tabs.** Drag diagram, monitor and start-page tabs, or use **Ctrl+Shift+←/→** with a tab focused. Content, the selected tab and command history are preserved.
- **Set a default flow from arrow properties.** Select an arrow → **General · BPMN** → **Default flow**. This updates the standard `default` on its source task/gateway; the existing source-node control remains available. Its outgoing-flow list now works even when XML omits explicit `outgoing` elements.

To transfer elements, select them on the canvas, press **Ctrl+C**, switch to another diagram, click an empty area of its canvas, press **Ctrl+V**, and click to place. The clipboard operates within one window; external processes, forms and resources are not copied automatically. Tab order lasts until the window closes.

The editor uses standard BPMN `default="flowId"`, supported by Flowable and Camunda 7. It does not create or interpret `flowable:is-default-flow` as a replacement for `default`; existing XML inside extensions is preserved.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are built and tested by GitHub Actions. Windows executables are unsigned; manual installer acceptance is not confirmed. macOS is not available.
